278299042.description:
A lot of three cracked open geode pieces with sparkling druzy crystal interiors in shades of pink and deep purple. The color appears to be dyed rather than natural. Each piece has a rough tan and cream limestone exterior with a white banded rim around the crystal pocket. The largest is a triangular half, the second is a rounded oval half, and the third is a smaller piece with an open cavity and a few golden specks in the crystal lining. No maker marks or labels are present. Sold as a set of three loose specimens with no stands or box.

Condition: Natural rough surfaces with small chips and loose grit along the broken edges. Light soil on the outer rock. No cracks through the bodies.

278444368.description:
Natural Gemstone Collection
Assorted Crystal Towers and Raw Specimens
Natural Mineral Gemstones
Varies by piece; 1.74 lbs total weight
Unsigned/Natural Origin
This diverse collection of natural minerals features a curated selection of both polished towers and raw specimen pieces. The set includes classic varieties such as Rose Quartz, Fluorite, and Howlite, demonstrating a range of geological formations from crystalline clusters to monolithic polished obelisks. Each piece showcases unique inclusions and color zoning characteristic of decorative minerals, perfect for geological study or aesthetic display.
Set includes four polished towers and four raw/tumbled specimens
Varieties include Fluorite, Rose Quartz, Howlite, and Selenite
Total combined weight of collection is 1.74 lbs
Towers feature standard six-sided obelisk terminations
Condition:
Very good condition. Polished pieces exhibit smooth surfaces with minor natural internal fractures typical of stone. Raw specimens maintain original crystalline structures. Minimal surface wear from handling.
